verdict.rationale: Sprinto has its own vendors module under its data library, with documented pages for Vendor Risk Assessment and for sending and reviewing security questionnaires. Its AI Systems module also documents reviewing AI vendor security posture and requesting documents from vendors. However, the core vendor-module evidence is only page titles, and data-access mapping and recurring review cadence are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: documented vendor inventory fields, vendor data-access tracking, recurring review cadence or scheduling, detail on how risk assessments are scored, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
